summary: Iter-6: full backend regression PASS (158/158) including 22 new P1 tests (OTP, Referrals, POD, Service Zones, WhatsApp, Admin Approvals). Frontend: signup page renders referral input + OTP step correctly, /referrals page structure correct. CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: OTP auto-fill is cosmetic only - the Input uses `value={code || devCode}` but `code` state is never set when devCode arrives, so clicking Verify Code yields 'Enter the 6-digit code' error and the entire phone-signup flow is blocked end-to-end through the UI.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Input renders devCode visually via `value={code || devCode}` but the `code` React state is never synced from devCode. handleVerify checks `code.trim()` which is '' → shows 'Enter the 6-digit code' error even though the visible input shows the 6 digits. Phone-signup flow is fully blocked in the UI. Fix: add `useEffect(() => { if (devCode && !code) setCode(devCode); }, [devCode])` OR simply call `setCode(res.data.dev_code)` inside sendCode() alongside setDevCode().

integration_issues.issue: Cannot complete signup via UI because OTP verify always fails client-side (see ui_bugs). Backend endpoints work fine (verified via pytest).

issues: Page renders but referral code shows '—' and stats are 0 when API returns 401/403; no friendly 'please sign in' redirect. Loops 401/403 requests in console. Consider redirecting to /login when token is missing.
Label reads 'Earned ()' with empty parens - looks like a missing currency code interpolation (probably `Earned (${currency})` where currency is undefined).

action_items: HIGH/BLOCKER: Fix OTPVerification.js — sync devCode → code state OR change Input to controlled-only with setCode in sendCode(): `setCode(res.data.dev_code)`. This unblocks the entire phone-signup happy path.
MED: /referrals — redirect to /login when unauthenticated instead of rendering empty dashboard with 401/403 spam.
LOW: /referrals — fix 'Earned ()' empty-parens label; render currency code or remove the parens when empty.

INFO: Admin UI tabs (approvals/zones/whatsapp) were NOT exercised end-to-end via Playwright in this iteration because the OTP bug blocked creating any user (including admin) through the UI; backend approval/zone/whatsapp endpoints are fully covered by test_p1_features.py and all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: OTPVerification.js:92 - antipattern `value={code || devCode}` for a controlled input means the state and display can diverge. Always sync via useState/useEffect so the source of truth matches what the user sees.

AuthPage.js - submit() short-circuits to OTP step when `formData.phone && !verifiedOtp`, but HTML5 `required` attributes on later fields (Delivery Address) still fire first, which is confusing. Consider moving the OTP gate before browser validation or removing `required` from address.
ReferralPage 'Earned ()' suggests currency variable is undefined - guard with `{currency ? \`(${currency})\` : ''}`.

P1 backend code (server.py ~5090-5500) is well-structured but server.py is now well over 5000 lines - the new sections (otp, referrals, service-zones, whatsapp, admin approvals) are good candidates for extraction into /routers/.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is rock solid (158/158). The one blocker is OTPVerification.js line 92 - once main agent syncs devCode into code state (one-line fix), the full UI signup → OTP → /referrals → /admin (with admin user_type) flow should be re-verified. test_p1_features.py is a clean regression suite for the new P1 backend endpoints. To exercise /admin UI without the OTP bug, register an admin via API and inject the JWT into localStorage (key likely 'access_token' or 'token' — check api.js).
rca of the issue: Bug: OTP verify always fails client-side. RCA: In /app/frontend/src/OTPVerification.js the InputOTP component is rendered with `value={code || devCode}` (line 92). React shows the devCode in the field, but the underlying `code` useState remains ''. handleVerify() guards on `if (!code.trim())` and returns the 'Enter the 6-digit code' error. Reproduction: open /signup, fill all required fields incl. phone, click Continue → OTP card appears, click Send Code → dev-code banner shows code auto-filled, click Verify Code → error 'Enter the 6-digit code'. Mitigation (one-line fix): in sendCode() after `setDevCode(res.data.dev_code)` also call `setCode(res.data.dev_code)`, then change the Input to `value={code}`. Alternatively add `useEffect(() => { if (devCode && !code) setCode(devCode); }, [devCode]);`.
